CM Slim Body Sculpting

Stubborn belly fat or soft, untoned muscles that won't change despite diet and exercise? CM Slim uses High-Intensity Electromagnetic Technology to give your muscles thousands of powerful contractions in just 30 minutes. That builds muscle and reduces fat at the same time, with no needles, no surgery and no downtime.

Treatment overview

What is CM Slim?

CM Slim is a non-invasive body sculpting treatment that builds muscle and reduces fat at the same time. You lie down while flat applicators are strapped over the area, such as the tummy, buttocks, arms or thighs. The machine then sends focused electromagnetic energy through the skin and fat straight into the muscle.

This makes the muscle contract far harder and more often than you could ever manage at the gym. These are called supramaximal contractions. The muscle adapts by becoming stronger and thicker, and the intense effort tells nearby fat cells to break down. The result is a firmer, more toned, more sculpted shape.

Read more: why it beats crunches and squats

When you exercise, your brain controls how hard your muscles work, and they tire quickly. CM Slim bypasses that, triggering thousands of near-maximum contractions in 30 minutes, with rest pauses built in.

Studies on this type of technology report around 15 to 16% more muscle thickness within 1 to 2 months, along with a noticeable reduction in the fat layer over the treated area. It's especially useful for areas that hardly change with exercise, like the lower tummy and the buttocks.

1. ContractElectromagnetic pulses trigger thousands of powerful muscle contractions.
2. BuildMuscle fibres grow thicker and stronger as they recover.
3. BurnThe energy demand makes nearby fat cells break down over the following weeks.
US FDA-cleared

CM Slim HI-EMT Body Sculpting Machine

CM Slim is a globally recognised body sculpting system using High-Intensity Electromagnetic Technology. Its focused field passes through skin and fat to reach the muscle directly, delivering the most intensive continuous contractions for muscle growth and fat reduction.

US FDA-clearedCE-certifiedHI-EMT technologyNon-invasive
HI-EMTHigh-intensity electromagnetic energy
ThousandsOf contractions per session
Twin applicatorsTreat both sides at once
30 minPer area, no downtime
See the CM Slim & Hipex Chair equipment

What happens in your body

The intense contractions push the muscle beyond its normal limits. It responds by building new fibres and growing thicker and stronger, just like after very hard training.

  • Firmer, more defined muscle
  • Stronger core and glutes
  • Better posture and support
Shows: from 2–4 weeks

The working muscle needs a lot of energy. This triggers fat cells in the area to release and break down their stored fat, which the body clears naturally.

  • A thinner fat layer over the muscle
  • Helps with stubborn pockets
  • Cleared gradually over weeks
Shows: over 1–3 months

More muscle and less fat on top together give a tighter, more sculpted contour. It's a flatter tummy, lifted buttocks or firmer arms, not just a smaller size.

  • More sculpted contour
  • Tighter-looking skin over toned muscle
  • Clothes fit better
Best at: about 3 months after the course

Treatment areas

Where Can CM Slim Help? Tap the Body Map

Tap a number, or pick an area from the list, to see what CM Slim does there.

Tap a number to see what CM Slim does there.

Arms (biceps and triceps)

Firms and defines the upper arms. Helpful for loose, soft-looking triceps ("bingo wings") and for adding shape to the biceps.

  • Firmer, more defined arms
  • Less soft, loose look
  • Stronger muscles
Session time30 minutes
Typical course4, over 2 weeks

Abdomen and core

The most popular area. Strengthens and tightens the abdominal muscles while reducing the fat layer on top, for a flatter, firmer tummy. Also helps rebuild core strength after pregnancy.

  • Flatter, firmer tummy
  • Stronger core
  • Helps after pregnancy
Session time30 minutes
Typical course4, over 2 weeks

Buttocks (non-surgical lift)

Works the gluteal muscles to lift, round and firm the buttocks. A popular non-surgical alternative to a "butt lift".

  • Lifted, rounder shape
  • Firmer muscles
  • No surgery or fillers
Session time30 minutes
Typical course4, over 2 weeks

Thighs

Tones the front and back of the thighs, improving firmness and shape and reducing the fat layer.

  • Firmer, toned thighs
  • Better shape
  • Stronger legs
Session time30 minutes

Calves

Adds definition and shape to the calves for more toned-looking lower legs.

  • Shapelier calves

What to expect

Benefits of CM Slim

Muscle building and fat reduction in one quick, comfortable treatment.

Builds Muscle

Thousands of powerful contractions in one session strengthen and thicken the muscle.

Reduces Stubborn Fat

The intense muscle work triggers nearby fat cells to break down.

Two Results in One

Tones muscle and reduces fat at the same time, for a more sculpted shape.

30-Minute Sessions

Lie down, relax and let the machine do the workout.

No Downtime

No needles, no surgery, no recovery. Go straight back to your day.

Non-Invasive

Works through clothing-free skin with flat applicators. Nothing breaks the skin.

Core Strength

Quick Course

Just 4 sessions over about 2 weeks, with results building over the next 2 to 3 months.

Swipe to see more

Is it right for you?

Who Gets the Best Results?

CM Slim is a body sculpting treatment, not a weight-loss treatment. Here's where it works best.

Toning

You're close to your ideal weight but want firmer, more defined muscles.

Best for: soft tummy, arms, glutes
Downtime: none
Sessions: 4 sessions

Sculpting

You have a small layer of stubborn fat over the muscle that won't shift with diet and exercise.

Best for: stubborn belly, thighs
Downtime: none
Sessions: 4 sessions + maintenance

Not a weight-loss treatment

CM Slim shapes the body but doesn't replace weight loss. If you have a lot of weight to lose, we'll start with a medical weight plan.

Best for: best with BMI under about 30
Downtime: none
Sessions: your doctor will advise

Swipe to see more

Common questions

Before You Book

I go to the gym. Will it still help?
Yes. Many regular gym-goers use CM Slim to break through plateaus and add definition to stubborn areas like the lower tummy and glutes.
I don't exercise. Will it work?
Yes. You'll still build muscle and reduce fat, and simple daily activity helps your results last longer.
I've had a baby. Can it help my tummy?
Yes. CM Slim helps rebuild weak core muscles after pregnancy. Start once your doctor confirms you've healed, especially after a C-section.
Can men have CM Slim?
Yes. Men often use it for abs, arms and a firmer chest-to-waist shape.
Does it tighten loose skin?
It firms the muscle under the skin, which helps the area look tighter. Very loose skin may need extra skin-tightening treatment.

Your course

How a CM Slim Course Works

A short course of sessions, with results that keep building after you finish.

  1. Sessions 1–4

    Over 2 weeks

    Four 30-minute sessions, 2 to 3 days apart. You may feel mild muscle soreness, like after a workout.

  2. Weeks 2–4

    Feel the change

    Muscles feel firmer and stronger, and your core feels more supported.

  3. Months 1–3

    See the change

    Muscle keeps building and the fat layer reduces. Best results show around 3 months.

  4. Every 3–6 months

    Maintain

    A single maintenance session, plus staying active, keeps your results.

Your appointment

CM Slim Treatment Procedure

A consultation and body assessment come first.

  • Your doctor discusses your goals, health and any implants or medical devices.
  • We check which areas will benefit and take progress photos and measurements.
  • Remove metal jewellery and any electronics like phones and watches.
  • Wear comfortable clothes. Drink water and eat a light meal before.
  • No numbing cream or special preparation is needed.

Each session lasts about 30 minutes per area.

  • You lie down comfortably, and the applicators are strapped over the area.
  • The intensity starts low and is turned up as you get used to it.
  • You'll feel strong contractions, tapping and tightening, like an intense workout.
  • There are short rest phases built in.
  • You can read, chat or relax during the session.

Get up and go straight back to your day.

  • No downtime and no marks on the skin.
  • Mild muscle soreness for a day or two is normal.
  • Drink plenty of water and eat enough protein to help muscle build.
  • Stay active with walking or your normal workouts.
  • Book your next session 2 to 3 days later.

Results

What Results Can You Expect?

CM Slim shapes your body gradually as muscle builds and fat is cleared.

A good fit if you

  • Are at or near a healthy weight
  • Have stubborn fat that diet and exercise don't shift
  • Want a firmer tummy, buttocks, arms or thighs
  • Want to rebuild core strength after pregnancy

Not suitable if you

  • Have a pacemaker or electronic implant
  • Have metal implants in or near the area
  • Are pregnant
  • Have a lot of weight to lose (start with a weight plan)

Illustrative model images. Results vary with the area, your body and your lifestyle.

Aftercare

Get the Most from CM Slim

Simple habits that help muscle build and fat stay off.

Do

  • Drink plenty of water
  • Eat a protein-rich meal
  • Gentle stretching or a walk
  • Get a good night's sleep

Avoid

  • Heavy, salty or sugary meals
  • Alcohol on the day
  • Worrying about mild soreness. It's normal

Do

  • Keep sessions 2 to 3 days apart
  • Stay active every day
  • Eat balanced meals with enough protein
  • Track progress with photos

Avoid

  • Crash dieting (muscle needs fuel)
  • Skipping sessions
  • Big weight swings

Keep up

  • Regular exercise
  • Stable, healthy weight
  • A maintenance session every 3 to 6 months

Remember

  • Results build for up to 3 months
  • Muscle stays strong with use
  • Fat reduction lasts with a stable weight

Myths vs facts

CM Slim Myths, Busted

"It's just an expensive EMS belt."
EMS belts use weak surface pulses. CM Slim's electromagnetic field reaches deep muscle for far stronger contractions.
"It's a weight-loss machine."
CM Slim sculpts and tones specific areas. It isn't designed for overall weight loss.
"It's painful."
It feels intense, like a hard workout, but not painful. The intensity is adjusted to your comfort.
"You don't need to do anything else."
Results last best with regular activity and balanced eating.
"Results show after one session."
Muscle and fat change gradually. The best results show around 3 months after the course.

Safety first

Side Effects and Who Should Avoid CM Slim

CM Slim is non-invasive and very well tolerated. Here's what's normal and who shouldn't have it.

Common and temporary

  • Mild muscle soreness for 1 to 2 days, like after a workout
  • Slight warmth or redness on the skin for a short while
  • Tired-feeling muscles after the session

Not suitable if you have

  • A pacemaker, defibrillator or other electronic implant
  • Metal implants, plates or screws in or near the area
  • A copper IUD (for abdomen treatment)
  • Pregnancy, or recent surgery or delivery in the area
  • A hernia, or certain heart or nerve conditions

Questions

CM Slim FAQs

What is CM Slim?
CM Slim is a non-invasive body sculpting treatment that uses High-Intensity Electromagnetic Technology (HI-EMT). It makes your muscles contract far more strongly than exercise can, which builds muscle and helps reduce the fat on top, all in a 30-minute session with no downtime.
How does CM Slim work?
Flat applicators send focused electromagnetic energy through the skin and fat into the muscle. This causes thousands of very strong contractions in one session. The muscle adapts by growing stronger and thicker, and the intense effort triggers nearby fat cells to break down.
Does CM Slim hurt?
No. It feels like an intense workout. You'll feel strong muscle contractions, tapping and tightening, but it isn't painful. We start at a low intensity and increase it as you get used to it.
How many CM Slim sessions do I need?
The standard course is 4 sessions of 30 minutes, 2 to 3 days apart, over about 2 weeks. Maintenance sessions every few months help keep results.
When will I see results?
Many people feel firmer muscles soon after the course. Visible changes build over 2 to 3 months as muscle grows and fat is cleared, with the best results around 3 months after the final session.
Is CM Slim a weight-loss treatment?
No. CM Slim shapes and tones areas like the tummy, buttocks, arms and thighs. It works best for people at or near a healthy weight. If you have a lot of weight to lose, our doctors can start you on a medical weight management plan first.
Can CM Slim replace the gym?
No, but it can do what the gym struggles to. One session gives more muscle contractions than you could do by choice, and it helps get past stubborn plateaus. Staying active keeps your results.
Is CM Slim the same as EMS belts?
No. Home EMS belts use weak electrical pulses on the skin surface. CM Slim uses focused electromagnetic energy that reaches deep muscle, causing far stronger contractions.
Which areas can CM Slim treat?
The abdomen, buttocks, thighs, arms (biceps and triceps) and calves.
Is CM Slim safe?
Yes, for suitable people. It's non-invasive, doesn't heat or break the skin, and needs no anaesthesia. Mild muscle soreness like after a workout is the most common effect.
Who should not have CM Slim?
It isn't suitable for people with a pacemaker or electronic implants, metal implants in or near the area, a copper IUD (for the abdomen), during pregnancy, or soon after surgery. Tell your doctor about any health conditions.
Can I have CM Slim after a C-section?
Yes, once your doctor confirms you've fully healed, which is usually several months after delivery. CM Slim can help rebuild core strength.
How long do CM Slim results last?
Muscle gains last with regular activity and a maintenance session every few months. Fat reduction lasts if you keep a stable weight.
Where can I get CM Slim in Kerala?
Facelit offers CM Slim at our clinic in Trivandrum. Contact us to check availability at our other branches.
How much does CM Slim cost?
It depends on the area and number of sessions. The 4-session course gives the best results and value. Book a consultation for a personalised quote.
